build_jwt_settings_api: build a Django API endpoint to retrieve and update JWT settings for the active organization
create_token_manage: create an API endpoint to list and manage API tokens for the current user
test_token_refresh: test the JWT token refresh endpoint that returns a new access token using a refresh token
review_token_blacklist: review the token blacklist endpoint that revokes and blacklists an existing API token
summarize_token_rotate: summarize the token rotate endpoint that creates a new refresh token and blacklists the current one
